chapter_title_en: The Breaking of the Stone Giant
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Battles Twin War God Avatars and Half-Ancestors in Epic Showdown
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen’s stone statue is shattered, but the Iron Battle Armor allows him to cut down war god avatars and wound the Asura Half-Ancestor in this epic battle.
og_title: Xiao Chen Wounds Asura Half-Ancestor in Ferocious Comeback Battle
og_description: After his stone statue crumbles, Xiao Chen activates the Iron Battle Armor and slaughters two hundred elite warriors while facing twin war gods and two Half-Ancestors.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen's Comeback: Iron Battle Armor vs Half-Ancestors
twitter_description: The stone statue is gone. The Iron Battle Armor rises. Xiao Chen nearly kills a Half-Ancestor and cuts down two hundred in a single battle.
